chunks: From him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn Salim and Jamil ibn Darraj and Sa'd ibn Abi Khalaf, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding a woman who has a servant (nursemaid) who has committed fornication, and her milk is needed; he said: Tell her to have the servant purify herself so that the milk becomes pure.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on the milk of a nursing servant who has committed fornication?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Istibsar*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) addresses the fiqh of milk from a nursing servant who has committed fornication, ruling that she should perform purification to ensure the milk remains pure (*tahir*) for consumption. This reflects the Shia scholarly view that sexual impurity does not inherently corrupt the physical substance of milk, provided ritual cleanliness is maintained, distinguishing between moral transgression and ritual state. The instruction highlights the practical application of *taharah* in domestic and nursing contexts within Ja'fari jurisprudence.
